csv_project_name: Consultant for ADA Transition Plan Update - Salinas
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Salinas Public Works Department is soliciting proposals from qualified professional firms to develop and implement a comprehensive Self-Evaluation of the City s Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Transition Plan (the Plan ) for City programs, facilities, and infrastructure, and to update the Plan. This Request for Proposals (RFP) seeks to secure the most qualified consultant to evaluate City policies and programs, perform field investigations within the City right-of-way and of City facilities, and to update the ADA Transition Plan identifying current obstacles limiting accessibility, providing recommendations to improve accessibility, and include a schedule for achieving ADA compliance.

title: Consultant for ADA Transition Plan Update - Salinas
short_description: Consulting services to update Salinas' ADA transition plan for programs, facilities, and infrastructure.
project_scope: Update and implement a comprehensive ADA self-evaluation and transition plan for City programs, facilities, infrastructure, public rights-of-way, and City facilities; includes policy and program evaluation, field investigations, identification of accessibility barriers, recommendations for improvements, and a compliance schedule.
services: Consulting services for ADA transition plan update, self-evaluation, field investigations, accessibility assessment, surveying/GIS/mapping, and planning/master planning.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily an ADA compliance, planning, and accessibility assessment assignment.
- No structural design, bridge engineering, building design, or special structural scope identified.
- Disciplines requested are surveying/GIS/mapping and planning/master planning, which are outside sbp's core focus.
- Clearly resembles planning/consulting rather than engineering design of structures.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated. The notice concerns consulting and planning services for an ADA transition plan update, not a defined construction project. No realistic construction cost estimate can be derived from the available information.
fee_explanation: No fee information is provided. The notice is for consultant services related to ADA evaluation and planning; no basis is given to estimate an sbp engineering fee realistically.
references_qualifications: Qualified professional firms for ADA transition plan development and implementation; no specific reference counts or detailed qualification thresholds stated in the notice excerpt.

notes: Target market listed as Streets/Highways, but the scope is citywide ADA planning for programs, facilities, and infrastructure rather than a specific building or bridge project. Questions deadline: 2026-05-29 02:00 PM PDT.
